text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen" has been decided!
With such a star-studded lineup, the post-race
emotions are truly exceptional!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With the new generation, led by
TM Opera O, joining the Golden Generation...
it has truly become a dream match!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Spe, Grass... I have clearly witnessed the history
your horseshoes have carved into the turf.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And—I shall see it duly passed down to me.
For I am the Overlord.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"To do that... I will have to settle the score
with all of you once and for all next year."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. Solemnly—all I must do is accept the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still... Opera O-san is way stronger than I thought...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: She's so amazing even though she's still in the Classic tier. I wonder what will happen next year~?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, to answer that question,
I'll just say: 'Things are going to get wild.'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is no end to the king's path. What I strive for
is to reign over the Umamusume world as the "Century's End Overlord."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
Ha-hahaha!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: *cough*, *choke*, *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! T.M. Opera O
chokes right here!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!?
I never expected live commentary here!
After moving everyone with a thrilling race, our star departed the venue while sharing laughs with the crowd.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose that marks the end of the Classic Year.
Good work, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And so, the epic tale of the young T.M. Opera O came to a close...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A new story begins next year.
As part of the Senior tier—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: A story where we fight as equals against the previous generation, that is.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
From here on out,
I can't just rely on learning from others anymore.
choice_data_list: You weren't planning to borrow it from the start, were you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha,
now that you mention it, that's right!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because I am the Overlord! A born,
natural-born Overlord!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: If I'm gonna borrow anything, I'd rather borrow some cash from you, Trainer! Bwahaha!
...Even though it was a joke, for some reason I couldn't really laugh.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun. When the new year arrives,
if a king of the next generation is to set their sights on something—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Which race would you recommend?
Please propose a race befitting the "Supreme Ruler."

A spring Senior-class race worthy of a king.
If so... there is only one choice.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Spring)! Ah, what a long-awaited,
beautiful ring to it! Truly the king among races!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Impeccable in both prestige and prominence! A magnificent 3,200-meter parade centered around true champions!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: This trial could very well be called the rite of passage for a new king!
And just like that, next year's goal was easily decided.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's settled, Trainer-kun. Starting next year with the Tenno Sho (Spring), we begin our victory road!
